$comment: Owner: detector-response. Typed fields of a response since contracts 2.8.0 (detector-response audit), applied by contracts.validate on top of ext_response.json only to artifacts of contract 2.8.0 or later, or to older ones with --strict. All optional here; contracts.validate._response_hardening makes intended_use and underflow_overflow required for a matrix (R1) and underflow/overflow required for explicit_bins with an inline matrix (R6).

underflow_overflow.$comment: since 2.8.0 the enum of core/stats/validate_response.py FLOW; ext_response.json keeps the free string so a 2.7 artifact keeps its outcome

underflow.$comment: per truth bin, same normalization as matrix: probability (or counts) reconstructed below the reco axis

overflow.$comment: per truth bin, same normalization as matrix: probability (or counts) reconstructed above the reco axis

correction_space.$comment: term of applied_separately -> where it acts: truth (per truth bin, before folding), reco (per reco bin, after folding) or global (a scalar such as luminosity, exposure or live time); order is the position in D_reco R D_truth

mc_stat.$comment: finite-MC uncertainty of the response: generated_counts and effective_counts carry events_per_truth_bin (generated, or selected when the inefficiency is outside), sumw2 carries a matrix-shaped sumw2, covariance_ref carries ref

systematic_variations.$comment: response variations; nuisance names match the statistical model that consumes them

periods.$comment: time-dependent responses: one matrix (or matrix_ref) per period with its exposure weight
